## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Buddhapakiṇṇakakaṇḍa* ("The Miscellaneous Section on Buddhas", Bv 28) is the twenty-eighth chapter of the *Buddhavaṁsa* in the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. It constitutes the penultimate chapter of the collection, preceding the *Dhātubhājanīyakathā* [Adikaram 1946]. Textual historians have noted significant discrepancies between the canonical text of the *Buddhavaṁsa* and its traditional commentary (*Buddhavaṁsa-aṭṭhakathā*); in particular, E. W. Adikaram observes that the commentary does not comment upon the final two chapters of the work, namely the *Buddhapakiṇṇakakaṇḍa* and the *Dhātubhājanīyakathā* [Adikaram 1946].

Automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies 57 Pali-internal text-reuse matches between this chapter and four commentary collections: the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Cariyāpiṭaka-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language alignments, DharmaNexus detects textual matches with literature detailing lineages of past Buddhas, including the Sanskrit *Mahāvadānasūtra*, the Chinese *Qifo jing* (七佛經, T 2), the Tibetan *Vinayavastu*, and versions of the Sanskrit *Saṃghāṭasūtra* [DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records two modern translations in two languages [SuttaCentral].
